findings.text: the recorded real-plan lengths do not reproduce: measuring a-worker-knows-it-is-on-compute.html section s3 at the reviewed head, and again at f05c311d whose reckon/ package is byte-identical to it, returns 11,376 compact JSON characters and 7,334 for the raw view (ratio 1.551132) against the recorded 11,354 / 7,357 / 1.543292, while the artifact is byte-identical (sha256 fcb5f896 matched by the payload's own content_digest, git blob unchanged across the reviewed range) and the result is stable over three runs; the same figures are re-stated unqualified at docs/plans/the-mcp-answers-within-its-ceiling.html:257, and the peer's measurement log names the base revision, at which no section view exists.

item_verdicts.diff: I read the whole diff in the reviewed worktree; the repair range f05c311d..806c0737 leaves the reckon/ package byte-identical (empty diff --stat) and adds only test assertions and an append-only evidence section, so the implementation under review is the one the prior review read while both of its durability findings are now pinned.
item_verdicts.done_when: I re-ran the declared gate at 806c0737 in the reviewed worktree (58 passed, exit 0, 5.97 s, reckon imported from that tree), and by name: the synthetic present-section payload, the absent identity refusal, the body-only discovery match and the terminal-authored boundary each hold; the real-plan bullet is recorded but its two figures do not reproduce (see the finding) — re-measuring a-worker-knows-it-is-on-compute.html section s3 against the byte-identical artifact yields 11,376 compact JSON characters beside 7,334 for the raw view.
item_verdicts.goal: I re-read plan §6 of docs/plans/the-mcp-answers-within-its-ceiling.html at the reviewed head and all four done-when bullets have named code: read_plan gains view="section" with an optional section selector returning one authored h2 section's heading, text, authored HTML, declaration, typed record and anchored comments, and discovery search matches a plan's authored body prose.
item_verdicts.manifest: the node's manifest records four commit shas ending at the reviewed head, the six changed paths, the focused gate with its 58-passed result, nine logs, and a negative_control_log whose first line repeats the declared mutation verbatim; the review-repair checkpoint names both repaired boundaries and the source restoring before the final gate.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed range 6d407358..806c0737 changes six paths, every one inside the node's declared fence — reckon/mcp.py (75 added, 4 removed), reckon/mcp_views.py (180 added, 1 removed), tests/test_read_plan_section_view.py (231 added), docs/plans/the-mcp-answers-within-its-ceiling.html (30 added), docs/evidence/archive/the-mcp-answers-within-its-ceiling-landed.html (100 added, 0 removed) and docs/figures/the-mcp-answers-within-its-ceiling/section-read-view.svg (48 added) — with nothing outside it.

justifications.durability: both prior durability findings are closed by mutation rather than by assertion — replacing the adjacent-record skip with break reddens the new copper-orchid assertion at tests/test_read_plan_section_view.py:192, and deleting the structured-region stop reddens the new terminal-boundary case at :213 with data-reckon="followups" in the returned HTML; the residual is that the skip-only variant of the stop (continue) still passes, and the new test asserts the two regions do not leak rather than bounding what a post-region sibling would append.
justifications.evidence: the gate re-run, the two independently falsified mutations and a three-run determinism probe are strong, but the real-plan measurement the done-when asks for is recorded as 11,354 / 7,357 / 1.543292 and does not reproduce — I measured 11,376 / 7,334 / 1.551132 at the reviewed head and, in a cross-revision control, at f05c311d against the same byte-identical artifact.
justifications.fit: the authored-prose splitter and the section arm live in reckon/mcp_views.py as the measure requires with reckon/_plan_html.py untouched, the new refusals reuse the module's ViewRequestError code convention (invalid_section_view, section_required, invalid_section, section_not_found, section_resource_required) beside the existing invalid_view and invalid_cursor, and the schema endpoint carries a section arm.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every done-when bullet resolves to named code and a named test, and the one gap is a recorded figure rather than a missing capability: the section view returns exactly the selected section's authored content plus its typed context.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed path is one the fence names, the evidence append is genuinely cumulative (24 insertions, 0 deletions at the head commit; 100/0 across the range), and the repair touched no production line.
